_comment: PC1 (the second library, SQL Server database Db2BDoctor, not Db2BDoctorNew). Copy to config.json on PC1 after collect_metadata.ps1 ran there and the operation and status codes below were read from its ZIP. The connector refuses a live run while any value still starts with '<'.

branch_map.<TxtBranchCode of PC1's library, from Tb: <its cost center, e.g. مكتبة المواساة - MMG>

operation_map._comment: TxtOperationCode -> document kind, filled from TblOperationInfo. Kinds: Retail Sale, Wholesale Sale, Retail Return, Wholesale Return, Purchase, Purchase Return, Opening Balance, Adjustment In, Adjustment Out, Transfer, Price Offer, Cash Receipt, Cash Payment

issued_status_codes: <TxtStatusRefCode of the issued state, from TblStatusRefInfo>

stock.heads: SELECT h.TxtIdRefStock, h.TxtNumberRefStock, h.TxtRegDateRefStock, h.TxtOperationCodeRefStock, o.TxtOperationName AS TxtOperationNameRefStock, h.TxtStatusCodeRefStock, st.TxtStatusRefName AS TxtStatusNameRefStock, h.TxtBranchCodeRefStock, b.TxtBranchName AS TxtBranchNameRefStock, h.TxtStoreCodeFromRefStock, h.TxtStoreCodeToRefStock, h.TxtCashDeskCodeRefStock, h.TxtCustomerCodeRefStock, c.TxtCustomerName AS TxtCustomerNameRefStock, c.TxtCustomerPhone, h.TxtVendorCodeRefStock, h.TxtSalesmanCodeRefStock, h.TxtPaymentTypeCodeRefStock, h.TxtSalesTypeCode, h.TxtCashValueRefStock, h.TxtCreditValueRefStock, h.TxtVisaValueRefStock, h.TxtDiscountPercent, h.TxtDiscountValue, h.TxtVatValue, h.TxtRemarksRefStock, h.TxtUserCodeRefStock FROM dbo.TblRefStockHead h LEFT JOIN dbo.TblOperationInfo o ON o.TxtOperationCode = h.TxtOperationCodeRefStock LEFT JOIN dbo.TblStatusRefInfo st ON st.TxtStatusRefCode = h.TxtStatusCodeRefStock LEFT JOIN dbo.TblBranchInfo b ON b.TxtBranchCode = h.TxtBranchCodeRefStock LEFT JOIN dbo.TblCustomerInfo c ON c.TxtCustomerCode = h.TxtCustomerCodeRefStock WHERE h.TxtIdRefStock > ? OR h.TxtRegDateRefStock >= ? ORDER BY h.TxtIdRefStock
stock.lines: SELECT s.TxtIdRefStockSub, s.TxtIdRefStock, s.TxtProductCodeRefStockSub, p.TxtProductName AS TxtProductNameRefStockSub, p.TxtProductBarCode, s.TxtStoreCodeRefStockSub, s.TxtProductQtyOutRefStockSub, s.TxtProductQtyInRefStockSub, s.TxtProductSalesPriceSmallQtyRefStockSub, s.TxtProductSalesPriceSmallQtyBDiscountRefStockSub, s.TxtProductSalesPriceBigQtyRefStockSub, s.TxtDiscountPercentToRefStockSub, s.TxtDiscountValueToRefStockSub, s.TxtProductTotalValueDownRefStockSub, s.TxtProductTotalValueUpRefStockSub, s.TxtProductVatValueRefStockSub, s.TxtProductCostPriceRefStockSub, s.TxtProductCostAvgRefStockSub, s.TxtAdjustmentResonCodeRefStockSub FROM dbo.TblRefStockSub s LEFT JOIN dbo.TblProductInfo p ON p.TxtProductCode = s.TxtProductCodeRefStockSub WHERE s.TxtIdRefStock IN ({ids}) ORDER BY s.TxtIdRefStock, s.TxtIdRefStockSub

cash_receipt.heads: SELECT h.TxtIdRefCashReceipt, h.TxtNumberRefCashReceipt, h.TxtRegDateRefCashReceipt, h.TxtOperationCodeRefCashReceipt, h.TxtStatusCodeRefCashReceipt, st.TxtStatusRefName AS TxtStatusNameRefCashReceipt, h.TxtBranchCodeRefCashReceipt, h.TxtCashDeskCodeRefCashReceipt, h.TxtRemarksRefCashReceiptHead, h.TxtUserCodeRefCashReceipt FROM dbo.TblRefCashReceiptHead h LEFT JOIN dbo.TblStatusRefInfo st ON st.TxtStatusRefCode = h.TxtStatusCodeRefCashReceipt WHERE h.TxtIdRefCashReceipt > ? OR h.TxtRegDateRefCashReceipt >= ? ORDER BY h.TxtIdRefCashReceipt
cash_receipt.lines: SELECT s.TxtIdRefCashReceiptSub, s.TxtIdRefCashReceipt, s.TxtAccNumberLevel5CodeRefCashReceiptSub, s.TxtAccNumberLevel6CodeRefCashReceiptSub, s.TxtAccNumberLevel7CodeRefCashReceiptSub, s.TxtDebitValueRefCashReceiptSub, s.TxtCreditValueRefCashReceiptSub, s.TxtRemarksRefCashReceiptSub FROM dbo.TblRefCashReceiptSub s WHERE s.TxtIdRefCashReceipt IN ({ids})

cash_payment.heads: SELECT h.TxtIdRefCashPayment, h.TxtNumberRefCashPayment, h.TxtRegDateRefCashPayment, h.TxtOperationCodeRefCashPayment, h.TxtStatusCodeRefCashPayment, st.TxtStatusRefName AS TxtStatusNameRefCashPayment, h.TxtBranchCodeRefCashPayment, h.TxtCashDeskCodeRefCashPayment, h.TxtRemarksRefCashPaymentHead, h.TxtUserCodeRefCashPayment FROM dbo.TblRefCashPaymentHead h LEFT JOIN dbo.TblStatusRefInfo st ON st.TxtStatusRefCode = h.TxtStatusCodeRefCashPayment WHERE h.TxtIdRefCashPayment > ? OR h.TxtRegDateRefCashPayment >= ? ORDER BY h.TxtIdRefCashPayment
cash_payment.lines: SELECT s.TxtIdRefCashPaymentSub, s.TxtIdRefCashPayment, s.TxtAccNumberLevel5CodeRefCashPaymentSub, s.TxtAccNumberLevel6CodeRefCashPaymentSub, s.TxtAccNumberLevel7CodeRefCashPaymentSub, s.TxtDebitValueRefCashPaymentSub, s.TxtCreditValueRefCashPaymentSub, s.TxtRemarksRefCashPaymentSub FROM dbo.TblRefCashPaymentSub s WHERE s.TxtIdRefCashPayment IN ({ids})
